producer_report.summary: Moved the Send-back row (unmet_criteria, left_to_athena, marked_left, is_athena_check_criterion, send_back_text, criterion_key) and mod left_to_athena_tests from run/mod.rs into the new run/send_back.rs. Function and test text is unchanged. run/mod.rs now has `mod send_back;` and `pub(crate) use send_back::{left_to_athena, send_back_text, unmet_criteria};`, so crate::run paths are unchanged and no caller was edited. In mod.rs I removed three imports the moved code no longer needs: LEFT_TO_ATHENA, CriterionCheckOutput and CriterionStatusOutput. In the test module I added `VerdictOutput` and `CheckRun` import lines, because `use super::*` no longer supplies them. I added a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased/Changed saying there is no behavior change. I did not run the full `cargo test --locked`; the targeted test run and clippy passed.
